yaml.text:
# Deployment and its service
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: chai-shop
  labels: &labels
    app: chai
    tier: web
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels: *labels
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        <<: *labels
        version: "1.10"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: "registry.example.in/chai:1.4.2"
          ports:
            - containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - {name: TZ, value: Asia/Kolkata}
            - name: DEBUG
              value: "false"
          resources:
            limits: {cpu: 500m, memory: 256Mi}

services:

      - "443:443"
    environment:
      - KEY=value
      - EMPTY=
    depends_on: [db]
    command: ["nginx", "-g", "daemon off;"]
  db:
    image: postgres:17
    volumes:
      - db-data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
volumes:
  db-data: {}
